tools.name: web_search
tools.description:
Search the web with NestDaddy's own index: title, url, snippet and domain of each page. For time-sensitive
    queries (a year, "latest", "today", "harga ...") fresh news articles are mixed in on top (type "news").
    Official sources are mixed in too: Stack Overflow answers for programming errors

tools.name: read_page
tools.description:
Read the full text of one web page or news article (title, author, date and the main text, without menus
    or ads). Use it after news or web_search when you need the details behind a headline.
    url: the page link from a search or news result. max_chars: 500-30000 (default 8000).

tools.name: research_papers
tools.description:
Scientific papers from arXiv, PubMed, CORE, OpenAlex, CrossRef, Europe PMC and bioRxiv.
    Returns title, authors, year, abstract and link. limit: 1-50 (default 10).
